author: Mark Atwood
text:
AUDIT TABLE (2026-08-28, decomposition per worker rules) - endpoint -> gate status -> child bead. All handlers in lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/; house pattern (w063) = coap_oscore_unprotect_resource_request + (!is_protected && !lichen_coap_is_local_admin) -> 4.01 via coap_oscore_respond_resource + read oscore.payload.

GATED (no action needed):
- PUT /config standalone coap_server.c:174-218 (inline OR-pattern; helper migration already tracked by children giol/dsrv)
- PUT /config modular coap_config.c:738 | PUT /config/radio coap_config.c:862 | POST /deaddrop coap_dtn.c:95 | POST /confessions coap_dtn.c:223 | POST /msg/sent coap_msg.c:948 (strict admin, documented in-code:963-964) | POST /msg/ack coap_msg.c:1926 (OR) | GET /msg/* coap_msg.c:1101,1334,1738,1795 (strict admin) | PUT/DELETE /keys/{iid} coap_keys.c:233,400 (strict admin per spec/11-lci.md 17.6.3) | POST /checkin + /rollcall + PUT /config/checkin checkin_resource.c:146,235,338 | POST /waypoints coap_waypoints.c:916 (+creator check) | DELETE /waypoints/{id} coap_waypoints.c:1059 | PUT /waypoints/{id} -> always 4.05 (safe) | POST /sensors/location coap_location.c:1293 | POST /.well-known/lichen-gw/handoff coap_handoff.c:996 (OSCORE-mandatory per spec/08:119; error-path gap -> worker6-vv1b)

UNGATED (fix beads filed):
- POST /diag/rangetest coap_rangetest.c:729 -> worker6-16zc (P1; unauth mesh peer triggers radio activity, DoS)
- GET /diag/rangetest MUTATES s_interval_ms + registers observer, no auth coap_rangetest.c:798-823 -> worker6-wr8j (P1)
- POST /.well-known/lichen-gw/slots coap_slot_coord.c:973: no dispatch gate; object-level Schnorr48 per GCP-6.3 only (coap_slot_coord.c:298-334) -> worker6-2hte (P1)
- Slot-claim REPLAY: no seq/replay tracking in C coordinator (zero matches for seq/replay); Rust side has durable high-water (bd worker6-07cg) -> worker6-gskf (P2)

INFRASTRUCTURE:
- CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_SERVER_OSCORE enforcement is per-handler and fails open when undefined (coap_oscore.c:45-89: OSCORE branch compiled out, gates degrade to admin-only); 11 handlers re-implement the gate inline, 2 drifted to no gate -> centralized helper + migration -> worker6-l9hb (P1, coordinates with in-flight helper children w1pp/fmee/h8b5/4hqw/dedy/2m4y/1vel)
- Tests: worker6-jkli (rangetest matrix, P1), worker6-6ffc (slot authz+replay, P2; no existing slot test dir), worker6-emvs (helper+admin matrix, extends tests/coap_lci_auth which today covers only address classification)
- Docs: Kconfig:233-234 claims BLE admin but code (coap_keys.c:51-98, SLIP-only) + spec/11-lci.md:724 (USB=admin, BLE=standard) say otherwise -> worker6-tl1z (P3)
- Final 3-perspective review (correctness/security/robustness) after fixes land -> worker6-6fxd (P0)

NOTES: GET /deaddrop (coap_dtn.c:170) is ungated by design - spec/11-lci.md 17.5.8 'Reads (GET) MAY be public'; flagged for review pass 2. No /sos CoAP resource exists in-tree (sos_resource.c is a state machine, sos_alert.c a codec); nothing to gate. No human-escalation bead needed: the transport->access-level policy is settled by spec/11-lci.md 17.6.3 and the strict-admin vs OR divergence between /msg handlers is documented in-code (coap_msg.c:963-964). Priorities: mesh/internet-facing ungated mutations = P1 > object-signature-protected slots replay = P2 > doc/P3.
